targets.rawSql: SELECT icao24, callsign, origin_country, latitude, longitude, baro_altitude, velocity FROM aircraft_current_state WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL
SELECT CASE WHEN on_ground THEN 'On Ground' ELSE 'Airborne' END AS status, count(*) AS aircraft_count FROM aircraft_current_state GROUP BY on_ground

SELECT CASE WHEN vertical_rate > 1 THEN 'Climbing' WHEN vertical_rate < -1 THEN 'Descending' ELSE 'Level' END AS phase, count(*) AS aircraft_count FROM aircraft_current_state WHERE on_ground = false AND vertical_rate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY phase

SELECT CASE WHEN baro_altitude < 3000 THEN '0-3km' WHEN baro_altitude < 6000 THEN '3-6km' WHEN baro_altitude < 9000 THEN '6-9km' WHEN baro_altitude < 12000 THEN '9-12km' ELSE '12km+' END AS altitude_band, count(*) AS aircraft_count FROM aircraft_current_state WHERE on_ground = false AND baro_altitude IS NOT NULL GROUP BY altitude_band ORDER BY min(baro_altitude)
SELECT icao24, callsign, origin_country, velocity, baro_altitude FROM aircraft_current_state WHERE on_ground = false AND velocity IS NOT NULL ORDER BY velocity DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT icao24, callsign, origin_country, baro_altitude, velocity FROM aircraft_current_state WHERE on_ground = false AND baro_altitude BETWEEN 0 AND 15000 ORDER BY baro_altitude DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT origin_country, count(*) AS aircraft_count FROM aircraft_current_state GROUP BY origin_country ORDER BY aircraft_count DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT to_timestamp((last_contact / 60) * 60) AS time, count(*) AS observations FROM flight_states_raw WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(last_contact) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
